pairs.target: wǔfàn qián bǔ liáng de nà yíduàn , bǐ péngzǐ běnshēn hái fèishíjiān .
pairs.english: The extra measurements before lunch took longer than the shelter itself.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭前补量的那一段，比棚子本身还费时间。

pairs.target: mǐlā ràng yīwén ná yìgēn xì mùgān dāng biǎndàn , zìjǐ zài dìshàng fàng mùpiàn , jìxià zhuǎnwān shí gāntóu sǎo guò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Mira had Iven use a thin wooden pole as a carrying pole while she placed wooden markers on the ground to record the sweep of its tip when turning.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉让伊文拿一根细木杆当扁担，自己在地上放木片，记下转弯时杆头扫过的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài zhù biān kàn , fāxiàn tā zuìchū huà chū de yánkǒu , zhènghǎo huì dǎngzhù nà yí dàpiàn kòngdāng .
pairs.english: Watching from a post, Tavi saw that her original eave would block that whole open space.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在柱边看，发现她最初画出的檐口，正好会挡住那一大片空当。

pairs.target: děng zuìhòu yígè shùjì wán , bǐng yǐjīng zài dài lǐ yābiǎn le , xìnghǎo réng shì gān de .
pairs.english: By the last recorded number, the flatbread was squashed in its bag, but thankfully still dry.
pairs.hanzi: 等最后一个数记完，饼已经在袋里压扁了，幸好仍是干的。

pairs.target: chīguòfàn , luó shīfu lǐng tāmen yán shíjiē wǎngshàngzǒu . jiù chēdào bèi liúzài jiǎoxià , yìcéng yicéng ràohuí zhànfáng .
pairs.english: After lunch, Master Luo led them up the stone steps. The old cart road stayed below, winding back toward the station in tier after tier.
pairs.hanzi: 吃过饭，罗师傅领他们沿石阶往上走。旧车道被留在脚下，一层一层绕回站房。

pairs.target: zǒu dào qiáotóu , tǎ wéi zhōngyú rènchū le zǎoshàng mǐlā zhǐ gěi tā kàn de nà dào xìxiàn .
pairs.english: At the bridgehead, Tavi finally recognized the thin line Mira had pointed out that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 走到桥头，塔维终于认出了早上米拉指给他看的那道细线。

pairs.target: cóng zhèlǐ kàn , tā yìdiǎn yě bú xì .
pairs.english: From here it wasn't thin at all.
pairs.hanzi: 从这里看，它一点也不细。

pairs.target: liǎngcè suǒ lán yìzhí yándào duìmiàn de yán tái , jiǎoxià mùbǎn yíkuài jiēzhe yíkuài , bǎn fènglǐ tòu zhe yuǎnchù shuǐmiàn de liàng .
pairs.english: Rope rails on both sides reached the rocky ledge opposite; beneath his feet, board followed board, with the gleam of distant water through the gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 两侧索栏一直延到对面的岩台，脚下木板一块接着一块，板缝里透着远处水面的亮。

pairs.target: qiáo zhōngjiān dǐ zhe yíkuài tūchū de yánshí , zài nàlǐ fēnchéng qiánhòu liǎngduàn , yán páng háiyǒu néng ràng rén tíng jiǎo de kuān tái .
pairs.english: The bridge met a projecting rock halfway across, dividing there into two spans, with a broad resting platform beside the rock.
pairs.hanzi: 桥中间抵着一块突出的岩石，在那里分成前后两段，岩旁还有能让人停脚的宽台。

pairs.target: luó shīfu jiǎnchá le rùkǒu de kòujiàn , yòu yǔ duìmiàn kàn qiáo de rén dǎ guò zhāohū , cái jiào tāmen àn jiàngé shàng qiáo .
pairs.english: Master Luo checked the entry fastenings and greeted the bridge keeper opposite before telling them to space themselves out on the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅检查了入口的扣件，又与对面看桥的人打过招呼，才叫他们按间隔上桥。

pairs.target: mùxiāng liúzài jiānshàng , tā zǒu zài zuì qián , mǐlā gēnzhe , jiēxiàlái shì tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: He went first, tool chest still on his shoulder, followed by Mira and then Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 木箱留在肩上，他走在最前，米拉跟着，接下来是塔维。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī liúzài hòu duì , děng qiánmiàn de rén guò le zhōng tái zài fàngxià yìzǔ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey stayed with the rear group, waiting until those ahead passed the middle platform before sending the next group.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师留在后队，等前面的人过了中台再放下一组。

pairs.target: dìyī jiǎotà shàngqù , mùbǎn zhī qīngqīng dòng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Under his first step, the board moved only slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 第一脚踏上去，木板只轻轻动了一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎshǒu dā zài suǒ lán shàng , zhǎngxīn juéde cūcāo , hái méi jué chū biéde .
pairs.english: Tavi rested his hand on the rope rail. It felt rough against his palm, but nothing else seemed unusual yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把手搭在索栏上，掌心觉得粗糙，还没觉出别的。

pairs.target: zǒu le jǐbù , jiǎoxià de qǐfú cái yánzhe xiǎotuǐ chuánshànglái .
pairs.english: A few steps on, the rise and fall beneath his feet began traveling up his calves.
pairs.hanzi: 走了几步，脚下的起伏才沿着小腿传上来。

pairs.target: qiánmiàn mǐlā luòjiǎo , mùbǎn xiàng chí le yì pāi , bǎ nàge dòngzuò sòngdào tā zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: Mira stepped ahead of him, and the boards seemed to pass that movement along a beat later.
pairs.hanzi: 前面米拉落脚，木板像迟了一拍，把那个动作送到他这里。

pairs.target: tā cháo bǎn fèng kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: He glanced through a gap between boards.
pairs.hanzi: 他朝板缝看了一眼。

pairs.target: shuǐ búshì jǐntiēzhe qiáodǐ de . tā zài hěn yuǎn de xiàmiàn , liàng dé xiàng yìxiǎopiàn shuāisuì de jìngzi .
pairs.english: The water wasn't close beneath the bridge. It lay far below, bright as a small shard of broken mirror.
pairs.hanzi: 水不是紧贴着桥底的。它在很远的下面，亮得像一小片摔碎的镜子。

pairs.target: mùbǎn zhījiān míngmíng zhī kōng zhe zhǎizhǎi yídào , tǎ wéi què hūrán juéde zìjǐ zhěnggè shēntǐ dōu néng cóng nàlǐ lòu xiàqù .
pairs.english: The gap between boards was plainly narrow, yet Tavi suddenly felt his entire body could pour through it.
pairs.hanzi: 木板之间明明只空着窄窄一道，塔维却忽然觉得自己整个身体都能从那里漏下去。

pairs.target: tā tíng le . mǐlā yòu zǒuchū liǎngbù cái chájué , huítóu shuō : " zǒu ya . "
pairs.english: He stopped. Mira took two more steps before noticing and turning. “Come on.”
pairs.hanzi:
他停了。
米拉又走出两步才察觉，回头说：“走呀。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn le , tuǐ méi dòng .
pairs.english: Tavi heard her, but his legs didn't move.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见了，腿没动。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián pá guò lú chǎng de tiě tī , cǎi guò huòjià , xiàmiàn zǒng yǒu qiáng , yǒu liáng , néng jiào yǎnjīng zhuāzhù diǎn shénme .
pairs.english: He had climbed iron ladders in the furnace yard and stepped on cargo racks; below there always had been a wall or beam for his eyes to hold on to.
pairs.hanzi: 他以前爬过炉场的铁梯，踩过货架，下面总有墙、有梁，能叫眼睛抓住点什么。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ liǎngbiān dōu shì kōng de , lián fēng dōu xiàng cóng jiǎodǐ wǎng shàng chuī .
pairs.english: Here both sides were empty, and even the wind seemed to blow up from beneath his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 这里两边都是空的，连风都像从脚底往上吹。

pairs.target: " mùbǎn méi huài . " mǐlā shuō . " wǒ zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “The boards aren't broken,” Mira said. “I know.”
pairs.hanzi:
“木板没坏。”米拉说。
“我知道。”

pairs.target: tā de shēngyīn bǐ zìjǐ xiǎng de yìng . mǐlā méi zài shuōhuà , què hái zhàn zài qiánmiàn děng zhe ,
pairs.english: His voice was harsher than he had meant. Mira said no more, but kept waiting ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 他的声音比自己想的硬。米拉没再说话，却还站在前面等着，

pairs.target: nàzhǒng děng fǎ ràng tā gèng xiǎng gǎnjǐn mài yíbù , piānpiān yuè jí , xīgài yuè xiàng búshì zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: The way she waited made him want to hurry a step, but the more he hurried, the less his knees felt like his own.
pairs.hanzi: 那种等法让他更想赶紧迈一步，偏偏越急，膝盖越像不是自己的。

pairs.target: shēnhòu de yīwén qīngshēng jiào tā , wèn yào buyào wǎnghuí zǒu .
pairs.english: Behind him, Iven called softly and asked whether he wanted to turn back.
pairs.hanzi: 身后的伊文轻声叫他，问要不要往回走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng huítóu , yòu pà yì zhuǎnshēn jiǎodǐ jiù luàn , zhī bǎ suǒ lán zhuā dé gèng jǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to look back, but feared turning would muddle his footing, so he only gripped the rope rail harder.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想回头，又怕一转身脚底就乱，只把索栏抓得更紧。

pairs.target: zhǎngxīn chū le hàn , jiānbǎng yīn yìzhí bēngzhe kāishǐ fāsuān .
pairs.english: His palms sweated, and keeping his shoulders tensed made them ache.
pairs.hanzi: 掌心出了汗，肩膀因一直绷着开始发酸。

pairs.target: luó shīfu zài qiánmiàn tīngjiàn le , ràng mǐlā xiān dào zhōng tái děng .
pairs.english: Master Luo heard from ahead and sent Mira to wait on the middle platform.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅在前面听见了，让米拉先到中台等。

pairs.target: tā tuìhuí jǐbù , méiyǒu shēnshǒu zhuài tǎ wéi de shūdài .
pairs.english: He stepped back a few paces without reaching to tug Tavi's bag.
pairs.hanzi: 他退回几步，没有伸手拽塔维的书袋。

pairs.target: " kàn wǒ de xié . xià yíkuài bǎn , búyòng kàn shuǐ . "
pairs.english: “Look at my shoes. Next board. No need to look at the water.”
pairs.hanzi: “看我的鞋。下一块板，不用看水。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shìxiàn nuó guòqù . xié biān zhān zhe báihuī , xiédài yìtóu bǐ lìngyìtóu cháng .
pairs.english: Tavi shifted his gaze. White dust clung to a shoe's edge; one lace end was longer than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把视线挪过去。鞋边沾着白灰，鞋带一头比另一头长。

pairs.target: tā dīngzhù nà jié cháng chūlái de dàizǐ , mànmàn bǎ jiǎo wǎngqián sòng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He fixed on that longer lace and slowly moved his foot a little forward.
pairs.hanzi: 他盯住那截长出来的带子，慢慢把脚往前送了一点。

pairs.target: mùbǎn yòu huàng le . tā lìkè suōhuíqù .
pairs.english: The board swayed again. He drew back at once.
pairs.hanzi: 木板又晃了。他立刻缩回去。

pairs.target: " děng tā tíng . " luó shīfu shuō .
pairs.english: “Wait for it to settle,” Master Luo said.
pairs.hanzi: “等它停。”罗师傅说。

pairs.target: tāmen jiù nàme zhàn le yíhuìer . fēng bǎ tǎ wéi de yījiǎo chuī dào lánwài , tā dītóu yào zhuā ,
pairs.english: They stood like that a while. Wind blew Tavi's coat hem outside the rail, and he looked down to catch it.
pairs.hanzi: 他们就那么站了一会儿。风把塔维的衣角吹到栏外，他低头要抓，

pairs.target: luó shīfu shuō yīfu méishì , xiān ràng tā piāo zhe . tā de shǒu tíng zài bànlù , yòu fú huí suǒ lán .
pairs.english: Master Luo said the coat was fine; let it flutter for now. His hand stopped halfway and returned to the rope rail.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅说衣服没事，先让它飘着。他的手停在半路，又扶回索栏。

pairs.target: hòu duì méiyǒu shànglái . wéi lǎoshī zài rùkǒu táishǒu , shìyì nàxiē tàntóu kàn de xuéshēng tuì kāi yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: The rear group hadn't come on. Instructor Vey raised a hand at the entrance, signaling the peering students to step back.
pairs.hanzi: 后队没有上来。维老师在入口抬手，示意那些探头看的学生退开一点，

pairs.target: méi gé zhe bànzuò qiáo hǎn tā de míngzì .
pairs.english: She didn't shout his name across half the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 没隔着半座桥喊他的名字。

pairs.target: luó shīfu shuō , kěyǐ dài tā tuìhuí qiáotóu , ràng lǎoshī péi tā zǒu jiù lù ; yě kěyǐ xiān dào zhōng tái xiējiǎo .
pairs.english: Master Luo offered to take him back to the bridgehead so the teacher could accompany him along the old road, or go first to rest on the middle platform.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅说，可以带他退回桥头，让老师陪他走旧路；也可以先到中台歇脚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe qiánmiàn nà kuài yánshí . mǐlā yǐjīng zhànwěn , liǎn bèi lán zhù dǎng le yíbàn , shǒulǐ niē zhe zìjǐ de shéng tóu , méi zài cuī .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the rock ahead. Mira stood firmly, her face half hidden by a rail post, holding her own cord and no longer urging him on.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着前面那块岩石。米拉已经站稳，脸被栏柱挡了一半，手里捏着自己的绳头，没再催。

pairs.target: " dào nàlǐ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “There,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “到那里。”他说。

pairs.target: dìèrcì màichū qù shí , tā méiyǒu kuà dé hěndà . xiédǐ yāzhù mùbǎn , xīgài gēnzhe ruǎn le yíxià , yòu chēngzhù .
pairs.english: His second step wasn't large. The sole pressed down on the board, his knee yielding briefly before supporting him.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次迈出去时，他没有跨得很大。鞋底压住木板，膝盖跟着软了一下，又撑住。

pairs.target: luó shīfu méi kuā tā , zhī wǎngqián nuóchū xià yíbù de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Master Luo didn't praise him, merely moving forward to make room for the next step.
pairs.hanzi: 罗师傅没夸他，只往前挪出下一步的地方。

pairs.target: dào le zhōng tái , tǎ wéi xiān bǎ shūdài fàngxià . yánshí cǎi qǐlái búhuì gēnzhe biérén dòng , tā cái fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí bǎ yá yǎo dé hěn jǐn .
pairs.english: At the middle platform, Tavi first put down his bag. The rock didn't move with other people's footsteps; only then did he notice his clenched teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 到了中台，塔维先把书袋放下。岩石踩起来不会跟着别人动，他才发现自己一直把牙咬得很紧。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ shuǐ dìguòlái , tā yáotóu , guò yíhuìer yòu shēnshǒu jiē le .
pairs.english: Mira offered water. He shook his head, then reached for it a moment later.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把水递过来，他摇头，过一会儿又伸手接了。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng ràng tā juéde zìjǐ zài shēng tā de qì , kě tā quèshí yǒu yìdiǎn shēngqì , yòu shuōbùchū dàodǐ qì shénme .
pairs.english: He didn't want her to think he was angry with her, but he was a little angry, though he couldn't say exactly why.
pairs.hanzi: 他不想让她觉得自己在生她的气，可他确实有一点生气，又说不出到底气什么。

pairs.target: yīwén yě dào le , fú zhe shílán zuòxià , bàntiān méi kāikǒu .
pairs.english: Iven arrived too and sat holding the stone railing, saying nothing for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文也到了，扶着石栏坐下，半天没开口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā nǐng shuǐhú shí , liǎngzhīshǒu dōu zài yònglì .
pairs.english: Tavi saw him use both hands to force open his flask.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见他拧水壶时，两只手都在用力。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě pà ? " " nǐ bié xiànzài wèn . wǒ běnlái kuài zhuāng hǎo le . "
pairs.english: “You're scared too?” “Don't ask now. I nearly had the act right.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你也怕？”
“你别现在问。我本来快装好了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yìshēng , xiōngkǒu nà tuán dǔzhù de qì gēnzhe sōng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi gave a laugh, and the knot in his chest loosened a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一声，胸口那团堵住的气跟着松了一点。

pairs.target: yīwén dītóu kàn zìjǐ de xié , shuō cóng hòumiàn kàn , tā de bāo yílù wāi zhe , chàdiǎn jiù shēnshǒu tì tā fú le .
pairs.english: Looking at his shoes, Iven said Tavi's bag had looked crooked all the way from behind; he'd nearly reached to straighten it.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文低头看自己的鞋，说从后面看，他的包一路歪着，差点就伸手替他扶了。

pairs.target: " bié lā bāo . " tǎ wéi shuō . " zhīdào . luó shīfu gāngcái yě méi lā . "
pairs.english: “Don't pull the bag,” Tavi said. “I know. Master Luo didn't either.”
pairs.hanzi:
“别拉包。”塔维说。
“知道。罗师傅刚才也没拉。”

pairs.target: mǐlā dūnxiàlái , bǎ zìjǐ de shuǐhú shōu hǎo . " wǒ gāngcái yǐwéi nǐ méi kànqīng lù . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Mira crouched to put away her flask. “I thought you couldn't see the path clearly,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉蹲下来，把自己的水壶收好。
“我刚才以为你没看清路。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , méiyǒu lìkè shuō méishì . tā yě méi bī tā jiē nàjùhuà .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded without immediately saying it was fine. She didn't force him to answer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，没有立刻说没事。她也没逼他接那句话。

pairs.target: lìng yíduì shàng qiáo qián , luó shīfu dài tāmen zǒu wán hòubànduàn .
pairs.english: Before the other group came on, Master Luo took them across the remaining span.
pairs.hanzi: 另一队上桥前，罗师傅带他们走完后半段。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān kàn mùbǎn , zài kàn qiánmiàn rén de bèi , túzhōng yòu tíng le yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the boards, then the back ahead of him, stopping once more along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先看木板，再看前面人的背，途中又停了一次。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí mǐlā gēn zài tā hòumiàn , děng tā zìjǐ táijiǎo .
pairs.english: This time Mira followed behind and waited for him to lift his own foot.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回米拉跟在他后面，等他自己抬脚。

pairs.target: dào le duìàn , tā fú zhe shíqiáng huítóu .
pairs.english: On the far side he rested a hand on the stone wall and looked back.
pairs.hanzi: 到了对岸，他扶着石墙回头。

pairs.target: qiáoxià jiù chēdào rào le nàme duō wān , péngzǐ suōchéng le yígè huīsè fāngkuài , pángbiān réng yǒurén zài bāndōngxī .
pairs.english: Below the bridge the old road wound through so many turns; the shelter had shrunk to a gray square, with people still shifting things beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 桥下旧车道绕了那么多弯，棚子缩成了一个灰色方块，旁边仍有人在搬东西。

pairs.target: tāmen zài nàlǐ máng le yíshàngwǔ , cóng zhèlǐ kàn , jūrán xiǎo dé xiàng tú shàng de yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: They had worked there all morning; from here, it was astonishingly small, like a dot on the chart.
pairs.hanzi: 他们在那里忙了一上午，从这里看，居然小得像图上的一点。

pairs.target: yīwén wèn huíqù néng bunéng zài bàogào lǐ xiě qiáo tài cháng .
pairs.english: Iven asked if the report could say the bridge was too long.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文问回去能不能在报告里写桥太长。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō kěyǐ , xiān bǎ chángdù liàng zhǔn . tǎ wéi xiào le , què méiyǒu shuō zìjǐ xiàcì yídìng búpà .
pairs.english: Mira said yes, once he'd measured its length properly. Tavi laughed, but didn't promise he wouldn't be scared next time.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说可以，先把长度量准。塔维笑了，却没有说自己下次一定不怕。
